task_title: Reach the obligation validator from the CLI: spec check / spec bundle, one document shape for both surfaces
task_criteria: PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py tests/test_verification_graph.py -q — expect a final line "64 passed" and exit 0; the same fixtures carry <test>, <verification> and <requirement> blocks and pass through the CLI (test_xml_specs drives auger spec ...) and the Python API (test_verification_graph calls validate_xml_specs). FAILIF: exit != 0, or the passed count is below 64, or a <test> block is refused as an unknown element.

PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python -m pytest tests/test_spec_validators_agree.py -q — expect "26 passed", exit 0: every fixture corpus under tests/fixtures/xml/ reaches the same verdict from spec validate and spec check. FAILIF: exit != 0, or any parametrized case reports validate rc != check rc.

PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py::test_spec_check_validates_obligations_not_just_counts tests/test_xml_specs.py::test_spec_check_refuses_a_missing_test_path tests/test_xml_specs.py::test_spec_bundle_emits_the_requirement_verification_set tests/test_xml_specs.py::test_spec_bundle_refuses_an_unknown_requirement -q — expect "4 passed" exit 0: spec check runs the obligation validator and refuses a missing cited path with the typed stale-test-ref code; spec bundle emits the requirement verification bundle as JSON. FAILIF: exit != 0 or fewer than 4 passed.

PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH sh -c "python3 auger.py spec validate tests/fixtures/xml/verification --repo-root . >/dev/null && python3 auger.py spec check tests/fixtures/xml/verification --repo-root . >/dev/null && python3 auger.py spec bundle tests/fixtures/xml/verification REQ-MIG-1 --repo-root . >/dev/null && echo documented-verb-forms-rc0" — exit 0 and stdout carries documented-verb-forms-rc0: the three verb forms printed in docs/XML-SPEC-SCHEMA.md run verbatim. FAILIF: any verb exits non-zero or the echoed marker is missing.

PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && grep -c "auger spec bundle" docs/XML-SPEC-SCHEMA.md prints 2 and grep -c "spec assemble <root> <requirement-id>" docs/XML-SPEC-SCHEMA.md prints 0 — the docs were corrected to the shipped interface instead of keeping the unparseable form. FAILIF: either count differs (2 and 0 respectively).

PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -c 'import auger; t=set(auger.SPEC_BLOCK_TAGS); k=set(auger.SPEC_BLOCK_KINDS); assert t and t <= k, t-k; print(len(k)); print(len(t))' prints 6 then 3, and the same PATH python -m pytest tests/test_xml_specs.py::test_schema_matches_the_validator -q prints 1 passed — so the API validator tag set is a strict subset of the six declared block kinds and the XSD enumerates exactly those kinds. FAILIF: exit != 0, or the printed counts are not 6 then 3, or the pytest arm does not print 1 passed.
